commits.headline: feat(voice): record end-of-turn traces for the offline bench
commits.body:
One JSON line per user turn (streaming partials, VAD edges, the cut and its
reason, the final, a truncation label, and any late batch final) appended to
data/voice-eot-trace/<conversation>.jsonl when VOICE_EOT_TRACE is on. The
STT_FINAL_IGNORED line for a streamed final already promoted now carries the
late final's word count and its delta against the promoted text.

commits.headline: fix(voice): take a wake fire's run only from the sidecar's fired record
commits.body:
An activation led by an accepted line filled its run from the first
outcome record in the burst, which could be the below-threshold miss
just before the fire (run 0). That pulled the patience suggestion
down. Fires now fill only from fired records.

commits.headline: fix(voice): report a pending output route, parse the toggle payload, trim tests
commits.body:
An unresolved output leg (routeState preferred_candidate) no longer reads as
untrusted_route on a trusted input: it is route_pending, an idle lamp and an
info log line, until the first playback resolves the route. An untrusted input
stays definitive and a degraded system fallback stays untrusted.
toggle_barge_any_route now takes a boolean or true/false/on/off, flips on an
absent payload and ignores anything else with a [barge] warning. The existing
trusted-AEC engaged/released console line is cl

commits.headline: fix(voice): free a rejected pin before the .env retry and cancel stale unloads
commits.body:
A pinned model can load and then fail the production-dialect probe; the
boot fallback switched to the .env model while that checkpoint stayed
resident. fallBackToEnv now unloads what the abandoned pin loaded (tools
and chat halves, never the .env model or TTS) before the retry, which
also replaces the pair-only cleanup in proveChatHalf.

commits.headline: fix(visual): space the sleep-flash blink shots one phase apart and check them
commits.body:
Each blink phase lasts 250 ms, so the 125 ms gap could land both shots in
the same phase. Shots now sit 250 ms apart. VHS still jitters around its
8 fps frame grid, so the script requires the 150x38 pair to differ
(capturing again, three attempts in all) and the reduced-motion pair to
match.

commits.headline: fix(voice): drop LiveKit from the EOT bench sidecar and harden Smart Turn errors
commits.body:
The LiveKit model licence only allows use with LiveKit Agents, so the sidecar
now scores Smart Turn v3 only: no /score/livekit, no runner loading, no
livekit dependency (re-locked), and /health is {ok, smart_turn}.

commits.headline: fix(voice): count a fired wake that follows a rejected line in the same burst
commits.body:
A burst that opened with a below_threshold or verifier_rejected WAKE line
reported as one rejection even when a fired WAKE line or an accepted wake
followed it in the same window, so the fire never reached fires, the
playback count or the threshold input. Prefer a fired WAKE line, and treat
any non-manual WAKE_ACCEPTED as a fire.

commits.headline: fix(workspace): key the agent prompt off its own action notice
commits.body:
Hub.Notice is shared with unrelated UI: a workspace preferences save
failure writes it too. While an agent compose was open, such a notice
replaced the draft, made Enter refuse a valid send, and was wiped by the
next keystroke.

commits.headline: feat(cockpit): add a palette row that toggles barge-in on any device
commits.body:
The voice agent runs barge-in only on the trusted echo-cancelling route
(PowerConf in and out). The new "barge any device" row sends
toggle_barge_any_route so the operator can opt in on any other route
and back out again. It sends no enabled flag, so the agent flips its
current setting.

commits.headline: fix(voice): keep the BARGE_ROUTE line to the agreed field order
commits.body:
Drop the extra why= token from the BARGE_ROUTE transcript/stderr line and key
the change-only reporter on enabled, reason, any_route and both labels. The
route verdict stays on the barge lamp detail and in runtime.status bargeRoute.

commits.headline: fix(workspace): hold Enter while a hub notice hides the agent draft
commits.body:
After a failed reply or redirect the dock shows the failure notice in
place of the draft and advertises "type to edit · esc cancel", but Enter
still resent the hidden draft with the attention version captured when
the compose began. After a "question changed" conflict that repeats a
request already known to be stale. Enter now waits until an edit clears
the notice, so it only ever sends the draft the operator can see.

commits.headline: fix(voice): re-prove models voice unloaded and both halves of a pinned pair
commits.body:
A picker switch back to an MLX model voice had unloaded trusted
mlxBypassReady and skipped the probe, so a failed reload left an
acknowledged route that could not answer. Voice now remembers the models
it unloaded (any served spelling) and re-proves one before switching to
it, from the picker or a spoken switch; a failed re-proof changes nothing
and no longer reads as local-eligible.

commits.headline: feat(workspace): draw the s sleep/listen flash on the v2 frame
commits.body:
The flash from #112 and #114 lived only in the legacy chip row and
statusline, which the live Workspace v2 frame never drew. The state was
live (the next s toggles from it, and the tick raises the frame rate for
it), but nothing showed it.

commits.headline: fix(voice): show whether barge-in is running, with an any-device override
commits.body:
The barge lamp read armed on every SPEAKING entry even when the route was not
trusted and barge-in never ran. One syncBargeAvailability now drives the lamp
(degraded on an untrusted route, off in wake-word-only), a BARGE_ROUTE
transcript line plus a [barge] route stderr line on change, and a bargeRoute
block in runtime.status. VOICE_BARGE_ANY_ROUTE and the toggle_barge_any_route
bridge command let the operator enable barge-in on any route. The cockpit logs
panel would have shown the new stderr l

commits.headline: feat(voice): resolve barge-in availability and the any-route override
commits.body:
Add a pure availability resolver for barge-in (wake-word-only, trusted AEC
route, any-route override, untrusted route), its transcript line formatter, a
change-only reporter, and the barge lamp reading, in barge/route-availability.js.
shouldEvaluateBargeIn gains anyRoute, which skips the trusted-AEC requirement;
every existing caller is unchanged. Export lineSafe from the gate ledger so the
new line shares its sanitiser.

commits.headline: fix(release): publish a public manifest from the private repo root
commits.body: npm refuses a private workspace package. The release job now writes dist/package.json without private or workspaces, and the repo root stays private.

commits.headline: feat(voice): add the offline end-of-turn scoring sidecar
commits.body:
Adds services/eot-bench, a bench-only FastAPI sidecar on 127.0.0.1:8783 that
scores transcripts with the LiveKit turn detector and 16 kHz audio with Smart
Turn v3. It is never on the voice runtime path; scripts/eot-bench.js (next
task) is its only caller.

commits.headline: feat(voice): add the wake-word activity report with tuning suggestions
commits.body:
Parse WAKE / WAKE_ACCEPTED transcript lines, USER lines and the
voice-wake-scores.jsonl records into one activation per burst, then
report per-model fires, rejections, near misses and playback fires,
with suggested OPENWAKEWORD_PATIENCE_FRAMES and per-model thresholds.
Keyboard wakes are counted but excluded from the suggestions, and
score records without an outcome never count as fires.

commits.headline: fix(cockpit): ignore acks from a superseded default pin too
commits.body:
A late model.set_default ack for a pin a newer ctrl+d replaced would
overwrite StatusHint and announce the older model as the default while
the catalog and the star show the newer one. The superseded-pin guard
now covers acknowledgements as well as errors.

The Agents-tab dock row showed Hub.Notice only when no compose was active.
Once a reply, redirect or stop failed and kept its draft, the row went back

commits.body:
A model.set_default command.error for a ctrl+d that a newer pin replaced
no longer reaches StatusHint, LastError or the optimistic star. The
newest dispatched pin id is kept apart from PendingModelDefault because
any model.catalog clears the pending pin, and a genuine error for the
latest pin can arrive after one.

commits.body:
The cloud turn lit the lamp for the whole generateVoiceTurn() attempt, so a
client tool running between provider rounds still read as a busy brain.
Begin on each model_request_start and release on model_request_end, ahead of
onStatus's abort/turn guard so a late end still releases, and release any
open round when an attempt throws or aborts.

commits.body:

the lamp dark:

proven (mlxBypassReady false), so a spoken "switch to local / auto" resolved
to Sonnet while confirming "Locked to local" / "Back on local-first auto

commits.headline: fix(voice): keep warm-ups from reloading a model a picker switch freed
commits.body:

rotation, grant re-warm or model-switch re-warm could send a generation to
oMLX under a cloud/Ollama default (nothing proven yet) or right after a
picker switch off MLX had unloaded the model. Gate it on mlxBypassReady, and
on a mlxReleasedByPicker flag while the responder is off MLX. A spoken
"switch to Sonnet" frees nothing, so its re-warm behaviour is unchanged.

commits.headline: fix(voice): read a mic suppressed by the user talking as open
commits.body:
MIC_READY_SUPPRESSED mapped every reason to an amber mic lamp. When the
reason is user_speaking the mic is open and hearing the user, and nothing
retries the suppression, so the lamp stayed amber through the user's turn and
the reply (a median of 38 s, about one ready cycle in five last month). Read
it as pass; the other reasons, where the mic is not open for a new turn yet,
stay hold.

commits.body:
Wire the gate ledger into the voice agent (spec WS2a): one gate.state bridge
event and one GATE transcript line per gate decision, one GATES summary per
turn, and a gates snapshot in runtime.status so the cockpit recovers its lamps
on reconnect. VOICE_GATE_LEDGER and VOICE_GATE_LEDGER_LOG (both default true)
turn the ledger and its transcript lines off.

commits.headline: fix(voice): preserve queries when joining MLX endpoints (#2129)
commits.body:
MLX proxy bases with query strings appended the API suffix inside the
query, sending requests to the wrong path and losing a query value's
trailing slash. A shared URL helper now appends the fixed suffix to
pathname, preserving the prefix and original query; model-list cache
keys retain distinct queries.

commits.headline: fix(cli): skip covered controls in snapshot refs and role clicks
commits.body: Role and ref clicks now use the same visibility check as text clicks, including one parent frame when the control sits in a nested iframe. Snapshot refs use that check too, so a hidden frame or an overlay is not a click target.

commits.headline: fix(cli): keep snapshot roots and names inside the right tree
commits.body: An empty href is still a link, a hidden main is not the snapshot root, and a custom-element main or dialog walks its own shadow root. Label lookup can see a sibling outside main, but it stops at the shadow root.

commits.body: The bright cyan plume passed the luminance row test, so the crop still included the wrist trail. Count low-chroma bone only, and clear the trail that hangs beside the longer fingers.

commits.headline: fix(voice): ignore non-plain objects as gate readings
commits.body:
isPlainObject accepted any non-array object, so a Date, Map or class
instance reaching set() was read as an empty full reading that cleared the
gate. Accept only object literals and null-prototype objects, as the
contract says. Found by Codex on #2128.

commits.headline: fix(cli): bound steps and keep snapshot and evaluate data
commits.body: Evaluate source is no longer rewritten by placeholder substitution, snapshot url and title stay in the step result, and the command deadline stops the sequence.

commits.headline: fix(cli): keep validation alerts in the scoped snapshot
commits.body: The scoped payload dropped role=alert and .error text, so a post-write snapshot could hide a failure like Card declined.

commits.headline: fix(cli): keep nav shadows out and name range inputs
commits.body: Slider and spinbutton inputs were published as textboxes, and a control inside a nav web component leaked into the default snapshot.

commits.body: A color wipe was eating the cyan rim on the glove and leaving the gray smoke on the inactive mark. Only pixels below the last solid row are the plume.

commits.body: goto --group-title without --page-name used the current http tab and dropped the title. It now asks the extension to group that tab.

commits.headline: fix(voice): ignore empty gate updates and log turn changes
commits.body:
- set(gate) with no update argument no longer reads as an empty full
  reading. With the `update = {}` default it cleared every field of a gate
  that held a reading; it is now ignored like any other non-object update.
- A change of turn is significant, like state and reason: it emits and
  writes a transcript line, never throttled. Only same-state, same-reason,
  same-turn changes to score, threshold or detail are throttled and go to the
  bridge only. A gate that repeats its decision in the ne

commits.body: Fill and type steps were sending {me:} and {secure:} literals, and an evaluate result named url or title was stripped with the operation wrapper.

commits.headline: fix(cli): refuse covered role clicks and publish implicit roles
commits.body: Role and ref clicks now use the same visibility hit-test as text clicks, and range, number, and multi-select controls keep their slider, spinbutton, and listbox roles.

commits.headline: fix(voice): wait for the turn-boundary recycled player to exit
commits.body:
When a new turn opens before the previous reply's drain recycle fires,
recyclePendingPlayerAtTurnBoundary kills that player but let the next one
spawn at once, so the new player opened the device while the old one was
still tearing down. Since 2026-07-27 that happened on 521 of 523
turn-boundary recycles (overlap p50 51ms, max 488ms). The idle and
underrun recycles already make processQueue wait for the exit; the turn
boundary now does the same.

per-utterance recycling. With recycling now the default, that advice would
lead someone troubleshooting the PowerConf back to the silent-after-idle
player. Point at the measured teardown data instead.

commits.headline: fix(finance): the dotenv guard also catches dotenv's KEY: value form
commits.body:
wrangler parses .env and .env.local with the dotenv package, which accepts
`KEY: value` as well as `KEY=value`. util.parseEnv only reads the latter, so
`CLOUDFLARE_ENV: staging` would have passed the I1 guard while wrangler still
applied it. A line-anchored check for the key with dotenv's two separators

ledger is still rebuilt from the served rows.

commits.headline: fix(finance): advance a Plaid cursor only from the delta the ledger merged
commits.body:
The step returned next_cursor and accounts while the ledger merged whatever
the R2 object held, so a step attempt that timed out and wrote late could
leave the ledger with one attempt's rows and the item with another's cursor.
Each attempt now writes its delta (with the cursor and the stripped accounts
inside it) under its own key, buildRunLedger reports the deltas it merged,
and publish advances cursors from that list only.

commits.headline: fix(finance): upload-credentials refuses a dotenv CLOUDFLARE_ENV and never echoes a parse error

wrangler loads .env and .env.local from its cwd and takes its target from
CLOUDFLARE_ENV there, which bypassed the shell-only guard: production secrets
could reach the staging Worker. The CLI now refuses (exit 2, naming the file,
never a value) when either file defines the key, even empty.

commits.headline: fix(finance): take the finance lock for accounting edits
commits.body:
The /accounting/* write routes (transaction and account edits, manual
entries, rules, vendor meta, reconciliation, AI propose, accept and
dismiss) rewrite overrides, manual entries and AI proposals and rebuild
the ledger without the finance lock. An edit during a scheduled refresh
could interleave two rebuilds, or publish new state beside a ledger
built from the old one.

commits.headline: fix(finance): reclaim a stale lock without deleting a live one
commits.body:
Reclaiming read the holder, compared it, then unlinked the path. Between
the read and the unlink another process could reclaim the same stale lock
and create its own, and the unlink then removed that live lock, leaving
two writers. Release had the same read-then-unlink shape.

commits.headline: fix(finance): lock every Plaid item mutation; spot worktrees; quiet publish
commits.body:
Link, rename and disconnect in local dev rewrite plaid-items.json too, so a
scheduled refresh that read the store first could write it back stale and
restore a disconnected bank. They now take the finance lock (link before the
Plaid exchange, so a busy lock never drops a new token) and answer 409 while a
refresh holds it.

commits.headline: docs: design hosted finance sync (Phase 5a)
commits.body:
Phase 5 splits into 5a (finance syncing on the host) and 5b (finance writes).
5a moves Plaid and Wise sync and the ledger rebuild to a Cloudflare Workflow on
a 6h cron plus an owner-only Refresh, with credentials encrypted on the Mac and
written via wrangler, and a shadow mode so the first hosted ledger is compared
with a local rebuild before it serves anything.

commits.headline: feat(finance): add a launchd schedule for refresh:finance
commits.body:
npm run refresh:finance:schedule -- install|uninstall|status manages a
LaunchAgent that runs the refresh every 6 hours (and once at load) with
--quiet, logging to ~/Library/Logs/wpf-analytics/refresh-finance.log.
Install refuses to run from a git worktree.

commits.headline: feat(finance): add npm run refresh:finance
commits.body:
Syncs Plaid and Wise under the finance lock, rebuilds the ledger once, then
publishes the accounting domains through publish-snapshots. The step rules
(skip unconfigured sources, publish only when something refreshed, never
publish after a failed rebuild) live in refresh-finance-core with injected
steps so they are unit-tested. A busy lock exits 75 so launchd retries.

commits.headline: feat(finance): add a finance lock and take it in the dev sync jobs
commits.body:
data/secure/.finance-sync.lock keeps the scheduled refresh and a Sync click
in local dev from rewriting accounting-* and the Plaid cursor at the same
time. A busy lock finishes the dev job at once with exit_code 1 and the
holder in its output.

commits.headline: refactor(plaid): extract the sync core into scripts/plaid/sync-core.js
commits.body:
Move the config loader, client, item store, live-file helpers and the
per-item sync out of the dev routes so the refresh:finance CLI (and later
the hosted sync) can reuse them. plaid-routes.js keeps the HTTP routes and
the single-flight job, and runPlaidSync now calls syncPlaidItems.

newlines, carry a partial line over, and flush it when stderr ends.

  the audit entry and the publish response report the stored size instead

- Tests: a publish injected between pointer reads, and a non-ASCII

commits.headline: docs: disclose published customer PII and set WPF_REMOTE_API in step 6
commits.body:
publish:snapshots uploads every top-level data/live file, including the
EDD files that carry customer names and emails. SYNC.md said those never
leave the machine. It and DEPLOY.md now say they go to the private,
Access-gated R2 bucket (principals only) and that staging gets fixtures.

commits.headline: fix(publish): keep accounting-state slugs out of the live-directory pass
commits.body:
A state file found in data/live (accounting-overrides, plaid-status, ...)
still published under accounting-state, so includeState:false (--no-state)
could return a state bundle and a stale live copy could publish when the
secure source was absent. The live pass now checks PUBLISHED_LIVE_SLUGS
only; state publishes solely from data/secure.

commits.headline: fix(worker): cap publish bodies at 10 MB and decode them as they stream
commits.body:
A 50 MB body could not fit a 128 MB Worker isolate once it was decoded,
parsed and re-serialised per envelope, and readTextWithin held every raw
chunk plus a combined copy before decoding.

commits.headline: docs(deploy): publish bodies are capped at 10 MB

commits.headline: fix(publish): publish only an explicit allowlist of data/live slugs
commits.body:
A valid filename was treated as permission to publish, so operational
exports that share data/live (presale and renewal outreach queues, CRM
sync audits, the payout queue, customer-health-by-email) would upload
customer PII in the edd bundle. PUBLISHED_LIVE_SLUGS now lists the files
the hosted copy reads: the file-backed UI endpoints, the accounting view
inputs and the freshness anchors. A contract test fails when a UI
endpoint or freshness anchor is missing from it.

commits.headline: fix(worker): cap publish bodies on the bytes read, not Content-Length

so the 50 MB cap could be bypassed before the body was buffered. Read the
body through readTextWithin, which stops at the limit. Tests cover both
fixes.

hosted copy then reads it as not connected, as local dev does, instead of
serving the last snapshot indefinitely. Other domains are untouched.

commits.headline: fix(worker): log why Access rejects a token and keep routes under /api/

Log the jose error code (never the token or its claims) when an Access token
is rejected, so a misconfigured audience or team domain shows in the Worker
logs instead of a bare 401. The route registry now refuses a path outside
/api/: authentication and CSRF middleware are mounted there, so such a route
would skip both.

commits.headline: fix(voice): keep the GitHub owner map while a GitHub grant is held
commits.body:
The grant reply carries the map only in the turn the tools are granted.
Grants persist for the session, but local history keeps ~40 messages, so
on a long session the reply scrolls out and the model is back to guessing
owners with the GitHub tools still loaded. While the session holds a
GitHub grant, both local lanes now render the same map as a system-prompt
section (localGithubSessionSection). With no GitHub grant the prompt is
byte-identical; a grant already rebuilds and re-warms the prefix.

commits.headline: fix(voice): guard unbacked memory-absence claims on the local tool lane

Memory holds LoRA notes. A negative claim about memory contents with no
recall that turn is as unbacked as a claimed tool result, and none of the
existing claim detectors cover it.

commits.headline: Default the speaker-embed sidecar to CAM++ common_advanced
commits.body:
A 13-model bake-off on LibriSpeech dev-clean (20 owners with 3-clip
centroids, 19 impostors each, 20 disjoint cohort speakers) put the old
English VoxCeleb CAM++ at 13.5% EER on clean 6s turns and 19% / 27% under
5 dB / 0 dB three-talker babble. 3D-Speaker's common_advanced CAM++ scored
0% clean and 1.0% / 8.5% under babble, ahead of TitaNet small/large and
ERes2NetV2 under noise, at the same size (~28MB) and speed (~21ms per
second of audio on one CPU thread).

distill" and "that's what I'm running now per my notes" matched the
first-person undertaking pattern (I'm + running + now), and the claim
guard's retry replaced a correct greeting. run/running now count as an
undertaking stem only with an object word straight after ("I'm running
the script now", "I'll run it now"). The other stems are unchanged.

commits.headline: fix(gauntlet): bound the runtime plane's warm-up request
commits.body:
Codex review: the plane awaits the warm-up, which had no first-byte
deadline and no signal, so a server that accepted the request and never
sent a byte would hang a whole nightly or A/B run. It now carries the

prs.title: fix(speech): await final results and preserve turn ownership
prs.body: Local Speech previously committed its partial text and canceled recognition before Apple Speech could deliver corrected trailing words. Manual Send could also classify an empty partial as an empty turn before a final arrived. This change ends audio and waits up to 750 ms for the corrected final, with the latest nonempty partial as a bounded timeout/error fallback. It preserves turn ownership and a newer utterance's capture state through older transcript handoffs and server echoes.

prs.title: Share PCM playback conversion and smooth packet gains
prs.body: The phone and durable watch playback had separate PCM conversion paths, so audio continuity fixes could diverge. Extract the phone's persistent converter, loudness processing, and adaptive startup threshold into a shared core. Feed each input packet to AVAudioConverter exactly once, retain split PCM16 samples across HTTP packets, ramp gain changes to avoid steps at packet boundaries, and drain retained resampler samples at final EOF.

fix(plaid): tax refunds book to income.tax_refund, not refunds received
prs.body:
## Problem
`plaidIsRefund` flags any detailed PFC ending in `_REFUND`, and Plaid's `INCOME_TAX_REFUND` matches. The categorizer's tier-4 refund shortcut (`txn.source === 'plaid' && txn.is_refund`) runs before the PFC mapping, so a tax refund lands in `income.refunds_received`, which nets against revenue on Schedule C line 1.

prs.title: fix(plaid): only real refunds take the refund shortcut
prs.body:
## Problem
`plaidIsRefund` returned true for any Plaid transaction with `transaction_type: 'special'`, whatever its sign. Plaid's deprecated `special` type also covers card autopays, transfers, ATM withdrawals and payouts, not just refunds. The categorizer's tier-4 refund shortcut runs before counterparty memory and the PFC mapping, so all of those landed in `income.refunds_received` at 0.9 confidence and reduced reported revenue in the P&L.

prs.title: fix(sql): enforce read-only transactions and tokenize queries
prs.body: Executable MySQL/MariaDB comments could turn a mysql_query request into an UPDATE while the first-word guard still classified it as SELECT. Reproduced against compiled main on MySQL 8.0.46 and MariaDB 11.8.9: wp_users.user_pass changed to the fixture marker. The patched compiled server rejects the same requests and preserves the row on both engines.

prs.title: fix(voice): validate prefix-cache probe CLI arguments
prs.body: The prefix-cache probe silently ignored unknown arguments and accepted invalid measurement settings such as `--tolerance bogus` (NaN), which made a fully cached round score as a miss. This validates every CLI token and value before probe execution, including endpoints native fetch cannot use, and makes imports/help safe without launching the model.

prs.title: fix(voice): track speculative remainder playback lifecycle
prs.body: Released speculative replies with remaining text bypass the normal playback lifecycle, leaving the session PROCESSING while audio plays. Track the owned remainder as SPEAKING, pair controller start/completion and preserve the existing macOS system-say fallback. Interruption now cancels that release, fences late output and prevents old settlement from resetting a replacement turn.

fix(voice): retain request provenance in escalation error summaries
prs.body: Escalation A/B runs already retain partial request metrics in error trials, but their returned summary errors omit them. Reuse the same normalized partial metrics so first-dispatch and later-round failures retain request fingerprints in returned errors, exported JSON and reopened stored run summaries.

prs.body: Addresses #1869. The parent issue remains open; tool consolidation remains future work.

prs.title: feat(gauntlet): preserve effective runtime request provenance
prs.body: Runtime gauntlet reports previously could not identify the effective model request, and the nightly stored baseline summary discarded per-case provenance. Capture a versioned SHA-256 digest from the serialized chat POST immediately before dispatch, then preserve the first request's identity in request metrics, failed sweep entries, and the actual nightly recorder summary.

prs.title: fix(voice): validate escalation probe CLI inputs before recording
prs.body: Malformed escalation probe arguments could start a recorder and reach endpoint work: single-dash typos and stray tokens were ignored, while empty or malformed URLs passed validation. Validate every token and each flag's value before selecting the workload or creating a recorder. Recorder metadata spellings and valid sweep settings are retained.

prs.title: fix(tool-filter): generate WordPress intent from catalog
prs.body: `execute this SQL query on WordPress` currently misses `wordpress-intent` and routes to the local model without tools. Generate the WordPress action alternation from authoritative catalog `.name` fields, keeping existing aliases and inquiry branches and adding the `execute` → `run` synonym. A checked-in catalog fingerprint and curated tests reject catalog drift until regeneration, including additions that use an existing action head.

prs.title: fix(reflection): reject non-executable local role models
prs.body: Reject reflection role references that exist in the catalog but have no executable local target. Validation reuses `resolveLocalModelConfig` and reports the role and reference before either adapter factory can run.

fix(reflection): exclude posts after historical cutoff
prs.body: At historical `runAt=2026-10-04T07:00:00Z`, a WordPress post dated `2026-10-09T07:00:00` previously entered digest evidence and allowed prior links. The collector now filters full publication timestamps before shaping, excludes invalid or missing dates, and uses the supported WordPress query cutoff.

prs.title: fix(reflection): report retained search results accurately
prs.body: Research retained one or two unique search results but told the query model that nothing usable was found when requesting another round. Report the retained count and ask for more distinct sources; preserve the zero-result feedback.

prs.title: fix(reflection): parse comma-separated chart values
prs.body: Comma-delimited reflection values such as `before: 41, after: 12` previously produced no chart. The parser now consumes each labeled numeric item before considering a comma followed by the next item. This preserves commas inside labels and grouped numbers while making comma, semicolon and newline inputs produce the same evidence-backed points.

prs.title: fix(workflows): normalize reflection publication and draft settings
prs.body: Workflow inputs expanded as strings previously published even when `publish` was `"false"`, `"0"`, or `"no"`. Fractional `drafts: 2.5` reached the writer loop unchanged and produced three drafts. Normalize these settings in the production processor so disabled publication has no side effects and fractional counts produce the floored number of drafts.

prs.title: fix(voice): defer announcements that lose playback eligibility
prs.body: Queued announcements could start playing after user speech began during identity resolution or TTS generation, switching the session to SPEAKING and clearing the live input buffer. This change checks eligibility immediately at PCM enqueue or system-say spawn and keeps the item pending until playback so it can deliver at a later eligible pause.
